mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO diet_meal_item( id, tenant_id, meal_id, food_code, food_name, amount, unit, grams, oil_level, energy_kcal, carb_g, protein_g, fat_g, fiber_g, sodium_mg, precision_level, confidence, grams_confirmed, sort_order, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{r.tenantId}, #{r.mealId}, #{r.foodCode}, #{r.foodName}, #{r.amount}, #{r.unit}, #{r.grams}, #{r.oilLevel}, #{r.energyKcal}, #{r.carbG}, #{r.proteinG}, #{r.fatG}, #{r.fiberG}, #{r.sodiumMg}, #{r.precisionLevel}, #{r.confidence}, #{r.gramsConfirmed}, #{r.sortOrder}, #{r.isDeleted}, #{r.gmtCreated}, #{r.gmtModified}, #{r.gmtDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_meal_item SET is_deleted = 1, gmt_deleted = NOW(), gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE meal_id = #{mealId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT i.food_code AS foodCode, MAX(i.food_name) AS foodName, i.unit AS unit, MAX(i.amount) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS times FROM diet_meal_item i JOIN diet_meal m ON m.id = i.meal_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.people_id = #{peopleId} AND m.meal_date >= #{since} AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.food_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.food_code, i.unit ORDER BY times DESC, MAX(m.meal_date) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
